brief: The 6 habits of the highest-performing remote teams in 2026.

slots.headline: 6 Habits of Top Remote Teams in 2026
slots.body: Remote work has evolved. Here are the six habits driving elite team performance next year.

slots.title: Default to Async Updates
slots.body: Replace endless video calls with thoughtful written updates. It respects time zones and deep work.

slots.title: Sacred Deep Work Blocks
slots.body: Top teams schedule protected focus hours. No Slack, no meetings—just high-leverage output.

slots.title: Automate With AI Agents
slots.body: Elite teams delegate repetitive tasks to AI agents, freeing humans for strategy and creativity.

slots.title: Focus On Outcomes Only
slots.body: Ditch hours-tracked metrics. High performers define clear results and trust their people to deliver.

slots.title: Intentional Virtual Connection
slots.body: The best remote cultures build belonging through curated social rituals, not forced fun.

slots.title: Radical Documentation & Transparency
slots.body: Decisions, docs, and context live in open systems so anyone can contribute from anywhere.

slots.headline: Which Habit Will You Start?
slots.body: Drop a comment below and share this with your remote team.
